title: Knockout Charred Dutch Beef Stew
description: A hearty one-pot Dutch dish featuring charred beef, emulsified sauce, and chopped parsley, all while being FODMAP-friendly. This stew is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until charred on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and charred beef back to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Stir in the chopped parsley and let it cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to emulsify the sauce, or let it cool and puree it in a blender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
